outcome: percentage of thinning of the scar region
cohort: The study included patients undergoing cesarean section.
finding: The unlocked uterine closure technique demonstrated safety and resulted in less damage to the myometrium, specifically lower niche thickness and thinning percentage in the scar region, compared to the locked technique.
mod_finding: The unlocked uterine closure technique during cesarean section resulted in significantly lower niche thickness and percentage of thinning in the scar region, indicating less myometrial damage, compared to the locked technique, though it required more additional hemostatic sutures.
